reasons.persona_fit: Speaks directly to the small-business owner in a calm, grounded tone, strictly enforcing human sign-off on money movement and obeying the zero-CTA constraint.
reasons.clarity: Logical flow from diagnosing failing spot checks to separating rule-based flagging from final human approval, written in clear, jargon-free English.
reasons.actionability: Provides a specific, achievable decision method: identify one high-failure check, map what breaks, and isolate human approval from routine verification.
reasons.factual_grounding: Makes no claims of past clients or benchmarks; properly scopes AI to flagging and routing while keeping money movement strictly human-controlled.
